messages:
emily_cs: alert — noticed median healthscore dropped for accounts created last week after the dedupe sweep; renewal dashboard shows extra red flags. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

devon_eng: saw the spike. dedupe change removed duplicate contacts which reduced contact_count and last_touch features. scorer treats that as recency loss.

leah_data: confirmed. the merge backfill also set contact_source=\"legacy_merge\" for many rows which our feature transforms downweight. proposal: temporary throttling playbook for legacy_merge rows with no telemetry to avoid noisy renewals.

mike_ae: please yes. AEs are getting lists with 'high risk' that they know are active.

devon_eng: rough rule snippet we can stage:
```yaml
rule_id: legacy_merge_throttle_2026
conditions:
  - contact_source: "legacy_merge"
  - telemetry_events: "== 0"
actions:
  - set_outreach_priority: "low"
  - add_health_note: "throttled_due_to_dedupe_backfill"
  - suppress_sequence: ["renewal-pulse"]
  - dry_run: true
```

emily_cs: playbook-bot can you run a cohort dry-run for merge-job-2026-09-02 and show suppressed sequences + ARR split?

sentry-bot: dry-run complete for cohort merge-job-2026-09-02.
sentry-bot: total_accounts: 1,254 — would_suppress_sequences: 1,012 (80.7%) — affected_sequences: renewal-pulse: 1,012; upsell-nudge: 312.
sentry-bot: ARR buckets: <10k => 980 suppressed / 132 allowed; 10k-100k => 25 suppressed / 50 allowed; >100k => 7 suppressed / 10 allowed.

leah_data: that distribution looks like noise mostly in low ARR buckets. good sign.

devon_eng: rollout plan:
1) enable dry_run in staging for 72h
2) add console card with sample export n=25 for "throttled_by_dedupe"
3) create alert cs.playbook.dedupe_throttle.block_pct >= 60%
4) log attrs: merge_job_id, dedupe_rule_version, premerge_contact_count

emily_cs: also want a one-line healthscore annotation so renewal dashboards surface the reason, and an #enablement ping when suppression > 40% so AEs aren't surprised.

sentry-bot: alert created: cs.playbook.dedupe_throttle.block_pct >= 60% -> notify #customer-success, #enablement.

mike_ae: thanks — i'll tell the team to ignore transient blips this week if they see them.

devon_eng: merging to staging now; will post dry-run logs when available. :rocket:

devon_eng: deployed to staging. dry-run logs: /playbook/dryruns/3323456789-dedupe-throttle.log

emily_cs: i'll monitor and follow up after 72h. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
